name: Capability-Gap Learning System
summary: Build a governed system that classifies why agent work is blocked, separates missing capability from missing permission, proposes the smallest justified improvement, validates it, and retries the original task without self-granting authority.
problem: Agents can misclassify permission or configuration failures as missing capabilities and expand their own authority instead of stopping or improving safely.
coreOutcomes: Retry of the original task after validated activation
requirements: Registry for agents, skills, tools, plugins, workers, and policies
Retry path for the original blocked task
boundaries: Missing permission is not missing capability
Blocked agents cannot approve their own expansion
